newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close off on lack of foreign bids.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close off on lack of foreign bids.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed gently off as foreign bids remained weak and lack of news failed to pique local investors already looking forward to next week's Easter holidays, traders said.
"It was a slow day ... the market's waiting for news of electricity tariff increases," said InverUnion broker Hector Perez.
The bolsa's 19-share index closed down 0.81 percent at 6,227.51 as 18 stocks fell, 13 rose and 10 closed flat, according to preliminary figures from the exchange.
Merinvest's composite index, which includes telephone company CANTV, closed off 0.87 percent at 96.18.

Total trade volume was boosted to 84 million shares, worth 8.4 billion bolivars ($17.6 million), as Merinvest brokerage cross-traded 40 million Sivensa shares and also 30 million Carabobo Industrial Corporation shares.
Sivensa closed off 5.00 bolivars at 140.00, while Carabobo gained 0.25 bolivars to 16.85. Merinvest sources said final clients were both local and foreign.
